common_fields_to_check: user, username, email (on login endpoints), password, pass, passwd, pwd, token, session, sid, client_secret, captcha_token
recommended_fix: Review the login/authentication response. Never return passwords, password hashes, client secrets, session secrets or reusable authentication tokens to the browser unless a specific token is deliberately issued for that client. Stop echoing secrets, rotate/revoke any confirmed exposed tokens, enforce server-side authentication and authorization, and set session cookies Secure, HttpOnly and an appropriate SameSite policy.
verification_steps: Inspect the actual redacted response; confirm no password/hash/secret is returned. Check token scope, expiry and cookie flags. Test unauthenticated and separate test accounts to ensure responses contain only the requesting user's permitted data.
status: Review required; not a confirmed vulnerability
